sourceQuote: They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
targetQuote: 他们可以非学位修读生的身份就读一个学年。一年后通过考试者将自动被正式录取。未通过者将在完成该项目的一些课程后，作为研究生返回其本国。
